title: Brochure Containing Japanese, Translation Of General Chiang Kai Sheks Speech Delivered On December 26, 1938

page_data.en:
6. 964 1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
                                S.l., North ... Station,
            REPORT              Date July 5, 1939.
Subject. Brochures containing Japanese translation of General Chiang Kai Shek's
         speech delivered on December 26, 1938.
Made by. D.S.I. Liu Sheng Chien    Forwarded by. C. Crawford

(FILE)

Some 500 copies of a brochure purporting to have
emanated from the Kuo Min Publication Society
(國民出版社) (no address mentioned) and
despatched to local Japanese officials and residents
were confiscated by Japanese censoring officers
serving in the General Post Office. This brochure
purports to be a Japanese translation of the speech deliver-
ed by Gen. Chiang Kai Shek on December 26, 1938 in
refuting the statement of Prince Konoye, then Premier
of Japan, and is alleged to have been printed with
type supplied by the Tung Shan Type Making Shop
(陳森記字廠), 40 Ave du Road.

Discreet enquiries from the firm in question
indicate that the shop does deal in Japanese type
but undertakes no printing. It has made no sales
of Japanese type during recent months.

As far as can be ascertained the following
printing shops in the Settlement are engaged in printing
matter in the Japanese language and are clients of
Tung Shan Type Making Shop:-

1. Central Printing Company (中央印刷公司), 359
   Nange Road.
2. Central Printing Works (中央印書館), Lane 108,
   12 Nansih Road.
3. Hu Kiang Print. Shop (沪江印刷所), Lane 815,
   3 Moone Road.

Enquiries in this direction have produced no information
which would tend to show that this brochure was printed

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ____ 
                                S.l., North ... 分局，
            报告              日期：1939年7月5日。
主题：包含蒋介石将军1938年12月26日演说日文译本的小册子。
制作人：警探长刘生建（Liu Sheng Chien）    转呈人：C. Crawford

（归档文件）

约500本据称出自国民出版社（國民出版社）（未提及地址）并寄给当地日本官员及居民的小册子，被任职于邮政总局的日本检查官没收。该小册子据称为蒋介石将军于1938年12月26日发表、旨在驳斥时任日本首相近卫文麿亲王声明的演说的日文译本，据称系使用爱文义路40号陈森记字厂（Tung Shan Type Making Shop / 陳森記字廠）提供的铅字印刷。

经向上述商号进行秘密查询，结果显示该店确实经营日文铅字业务，但不承接印刷业务。近几个月来，该店未售出任何日文铅字。

据查，租界内以下印刷所从事日文印刷业务，且均为陈森记字厂的客户：

1. 中央印刷公司（Central Printing Company / 中央印刷公司），南格路359号。
2. 中央印书馆（Central Printing Works / 中央印書館），南市路12号108弄。
3. 沪江印刷所（Hu Kiang Print. Shop / 沪江印刷所），慕尔路3号815弄。

沿此方向的调查并未产生任何表明该小册子系由上述三家商号之一印刷的信息。

Extensive enquiries made amongst the local printing
offices with a view to ascertaining the origin of the
document have met with failure.

In order to find the source it has been ascertained
that the circular was delivered to local Chinese
residents by a "Japanese Anti-War League" (日本反戰同盟會)
formed and sponsored by the Japanese themselves.
It is a secret organization and efforts to locate its
offices have been unsuccessful.

page_data.en:
Pamphlets containing Japanese translation of General
Chiang Kai-shek's speech.

The attached pamphlet contains Japanese translation
of the speech given by General Chiang Kai-shek in Chungking
on the occasion of Memorial Week of Late Dr. Sun Yet-sen
on December 26, 1938, in rejection of the statement of
Prince F. Konoe, then the Prime Minister of Japan, given on
December 22, 1938.

Some 500 copies of this pamphlets which were contained
in envelopes and addressed to local Japanese officials and
civilians were recently confiscated by Japanese censoring
officers serving in the General Post Office. The recipients'
names and addresses were spelled in Roman scripts and the mails
were posted in Shanghai according to the cancellation stamps.

There are only two shops dealing in Japanese printing
types in Shanghai, namely, Hwa Foong Printing and Type Making
Establishment (華豐印刷鑄字所) at the corner of Chekiang and
Peking Roads, and Lung Chun Kyi (陳森記) at the corner of
Avenue Road and Changsha Road. The former concern produces
printing types by themselves, while the latter is dealing in
printing types imported from Japan, and it is believed that
the printing types which were used in printing this pamphlets
were supplied by the latter mentioned shop, because the form
of the characters in this pamphlets is different from those
printing types produced by the Hwa Foong Printing and Type
Making Establishment, but they are similar to Japanese made
printing types.

According to an expert the paper used for this pamphlet
is not one produced in Japan, but it is produced in foreign
country and the pamphlets were printed by means of matrix
system except the last two pages.

It is requested to detect printers or the person who
ordered the printing and that remaining copies of this
pamphlets be confiscated.
page_data.zh:
包含蒋介石将军演说日文译本的小册子。

附件中的小册子包含蒋介石将军于1938年12月26日，在孙中山博士逝世纪念周期间于重庆发表的演说的日文译本，该演说旨在驳斥时任日本首相近卫文麿亲王于1938年12月22日发表的声明。

近期，任职于邮政总局的日本检查官没收了约500本装在信封内、写给当地日本官员和平民的小册子。根据邮戳显示，收件人的姓名和地址均以罗马字母拼写，邮件在上海投寄。

上海仅有两家经营日文印刷铅字的商号，即位于浙江路与北京路拐角处的华丰印刷铸字所（Hwa Foong Printing and Type Making Establishment / 華豐印刷鑄字所），以及位于爱文义路与长沙路拐角处的陈森记（Lung Chun Kyi / 陳森記）。前者自行生产印刷铅字，而后者经销从日本进口的印刷铅字。据信，印刷该小册子所使用的铅字由后者供应，因为该小册子中的字形与华丰印刷铸字所生产的铅字不同，但与日本制造的铅字相似。

据专家称，该小册子所用纸张并非日本生产，而是外国生产；除最后两页外，该小册子系采用活版排版系统印刷。

现请求侦缉印刷者或委托印刷之人，并没收该小册子的剩余副本。
